load_f1_metric: load the F1 evaluation metric module using evaluate.load("f1")
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the F1 metric evaluation module
combine_metrics: combine multiple evaluation metrics like accuracy and f1 using evaluate.combine(["accuracy", "f1"])
compute_metric: compute the F1 score given predictions and references using the loaded metric module
list_evaluation_modules: list all available evaluation modules using evaluate.list_evaluation_modules()
